title: Unit Event — Our Constellation of Song — Episode5 More Than Admiration

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has done it at last. They've been signed by a record label! Reflecting on all of the people whose support has taken them this far, Ichika thinks of a way for the band to show their gratitude.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, thank goodness! There you are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay?
Practice isn't supposed to start until much later, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
That's right...
But I wanted to talk with you before that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. So, we started preparing for that show we talked about the other day...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which gave me a chance to think.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Singing and music have allowed me to meet and connect with all these different people...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Miku, you connected me with so many people...
Not only that, you helped reunite me with my best friends.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I really need to thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, I think I've said something similar before...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Your songs have such incredible powers...
Not only did they help bring my old friends back together, they're helping me make new ones as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been able to meet so many new faces, thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I could see your sincerity when you said that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Neither I nor the Miku of your world deserve all the credit, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You did all the hard work.
You took your feelings seriously.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I think you're an incredible person, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because you've also brought so many people together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. You did everything you could to bring Leo/need back together, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I don't deserve all the credit.
Saki was really vocal about...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, what about that brother and sister who ended up becoming separated?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You did your absolute best to write lyrics for them, and you succeeded in bringing them back together...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which is why I believe you have the power to bring people together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Like the person you admire so much. The Miku from your world.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I did, huh...?
I brought them together... Like you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you're capable of even more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As you keep playing music that moves the hearts of more and more people. As you convey how you really feel...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You'll sing songs that can bring more and more people together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: At least, that's what I believe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll treasure what you've taught me and keep bringing more people together through music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good. And I'll keep supporting you as best I can, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're cleaning up that classroom over there and were hoping that you'd lend us a quick hand!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then, should I join as well?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But you have practice soon.
You should be focusing your energy on your show.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So, I'll see you later.
I'm looking forward to seeing your show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Bye bye, Ichi!
Good luck with practice and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've never thought of it that way since I've always been looking up to her. We seemed worlds apart in that sense...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This show is our chance to thank everyone for giving us so much support...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But... I believe Miku deserves a special thanks.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (How do I do that? Something that she'd really enjoy would be best...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This song is going to let me sing with all of you in your world.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Obviously, I'm not the same Miku that's in your world...
However, while listening to this song, I got the feeling that it connects me to all of you girls.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichi, you're already here!
You must be raring to go!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, so... I have a suggestion regarding our next show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I don't know if it's actually possible, but I'd like to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, give what a try? Tell us more!
